status_note: POST-HOC. E1's candidate set was frozen before its first fit and nothing here was added to it. These numbers extend E1's ablation coverage and must be reported as a separate, explicitly post-hoc study with their own multiplicity accounting. No p-value is computed and none may be quoted.

provenance.join: by image id across all three caches; rows missing anywhere are dropped from every candidate, never from one
provenance.descriptor_note: raw cached 163-dim image descriptor + no reduction (transform=False). The PCA-reduced 8-dim vector is NOT used: comparing candidates against a compressed control would understate C1.

study_a_lattice.arm_grid_note: identical for every cell, so a cell's score cannot differ from another's because it was given a different classifier search
study_a_lattice.cv_note: 5-fold StratifiedGroupKFold on TRAIN, grouped by patient, scoring average_precision
study_a_lattice.multiplicity_note: 7 cells x 3 arms = 21 fits on one condition, chosen AFTER E1's results were seen. No p-value is computed here and none may be quoted from this study; the bootstrap intervals are descriptive.

marginal_contributions.note: mean over the non-empty subsets each block can be added to. The singleton model (block alone vs nothing) is excluded because no empty-feature model was fitted, so these are means over 2 of the 3 Shapley coalitions and are NOT exact Shapley values.

pool.source: frozen TRAIN + frozen VALIDATION of the primary condition

study_b_split_sensitivity.interpretation_note: A resplit changes which patients are scored, so the spread here is the sampling variability of the validation estimate itself. It is NOT a confidence interval for the frozen split's number and must not be quoted as one.
